description:
The Boy Who Lost His Temper: Cooling Down the Volcano! — Leo felt like a red-hot volcano ready to blast lava everywhere! How did the 3-breath magic trick save the day?
Kids science answer for "kids anger management cartoon story" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When we get furious, our brain's fight-or-flight switch fires; taking 3 deep belly breaths cools our brain down and prevents hurtful words.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
